news_cards.title: Cabinet Clears Rs 23,731-Crore GOBARdhan Scheme aur Rs 8,970-Crore Assam Corridor
bullets: Bullet 1: Cabinet ne GOBARdhan Scheme aur Assam Corridor ke liye manjuri di hai, jismein Guwahati se Tezpur ke beech 4-lane highway banaya jayega
Bullet 2: Is scheme ke liye kul 23,731 crore rupye aur Assam Corridor ke liye 8,970 crore rupye ka budget outlay hai
Bullet 3: Yeh scheme Bharat mein infrastructure aur connectivity ko badhane ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai, jo desh ke vikas mein madad karega
